data.long_meaning: The name Vora is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vrtra', which refers to a serpent demon that was slain by Indra, the god of thunder and rain. The name Vora is believed to bring prosperity and wealth to the bearer. It is also considered a symbol of strength, power, and courage. The name Vora carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vora usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
